note: The fixed question set behind the product score (docs/domains/quality.md「产品成绩（固定测评题）」). A run is one generation per question, judged only by the fixed operations below; changing any byte changes the set's SHA-256 and invalidates every recorded score and official baseline, so a new set is a new file and a new version.

questions.prompt: What is 17 × 23? Reply with only the number.
What is the sum of all integers from 1 through 100? Reply with only the number.
What is 2^10? Reply with only the number.
What is 15% of 240? Reply with only the number.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30? Reply with only the number.
If today is Tuesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Reply with only the day name.
How many prime numbers are there from 10 through 30, inclusive? Reply with only the number.
All bloops are razzies. All razzies are lazzies. Are all bloops lazzies? Reply with only yes or no.
Alice is taller than Bob. Bob is taller than Carol. Who is the shortest? Reply with only the name.
A father is 30 years older than his son. In 10 years, the father will be twice as old as the son. How old is the son now? Reply with only the number.
Reverse the string `axiom-quality` exactly. Reply with only the reversed string.
Sort these integers in ascending order: 42, 7, 19, 3, 88. Reply with only the numbers separated by commas and a space.
Replace every occurrence of `cat` with `dog` in this sentence: `the cat sat on the cat mat`. Reply with only the result.
